entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah with VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I need to return this VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm looking at it right now and I just don't want it. I want a refund immediately.

I'm certainly sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with the band. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Look, don't read me a script. It doesn't matter why. I want my money back. I know your return policy, so either you process this now or I'll be leaving reviews on every single website I can find. Do you want me to do that?
I understand your frustration, and I want to resolve this for you quickly. Can I please get your order number to start?
It's VF-982-115. And don't you dare tell me it's 'too late' or give me some nonsense excuse about hygiene and sanitation. I've had it for barely over a week.
Thank you for that. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see the account. And I want to assure you, that won't be an issue at all. I can see the band was delivered nine days ago, on January 2nd.
Our company policy for the VeloBand GPS Tracker is a 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe, so I can approve this return for a full refund right now. No problem at all.
Oh. Okay. So you're approving it? A full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak. Please place the device in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be credited back to your card.
A pre-paid label is on its way to my email? Okay. Well, good. That's what I expected.

It should be there now. And again, I do apologize for the initial frustration. I see you're a VIP customer with us, and we truly value your business. As a courtesy, I've also added a credit to your account for free expedited shipping on your next VeloFit order.
Oh. Free shipping? Alright. That's... thank you, Sarah. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly.
You are very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
